topic: Front Door FR1 Lamp Color Control Logic
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific condition or action related to the operation of the front door FR1 lamp's color control system.

column_semantics.Column 1: Condition/Action Category (e.g., Precondition, Trigger Condition, Execution Action, Exit Condition, Exception Handling)
column_semantics.Column 2: Description of the corresponding condition or action

core_entities.name: DoorFR1LampColorCmd_l
core_entities.description: Local control module's request for color change.

core_entities.name: DoorFR1LampOnOff_l
core_entities.description: Local control module's request to turn the lamp on/off.

core_entities.name: DoorFR1LampFadeSpdCmd_l
core_entities.description: Speed command for fading transition when turning off the lamp.

core_entities.name: ZCU_LIN_Signal
core_entities.description: LIN communication signal from Zone Control Unit (ZCU).

core_entities.name: Front Door FR1 Lamp
core_entities.description: The actual lighting output of the front door FR1 lamp.

core_entities.name: PWM Driver
core_entities.description: Module responsible for driving the PWM signals to control the lamp's color and brightness.

core_conditions.name: Precondition
core_conditions.description: The ambient light is in an enabled state.

core_conditions.name: Trigger Condition
core_conditions.description: A change in the DoorFR1LampColorCmd_l signal from 'No Request' (0x00) to a non-zero value.

core_conditions.name: Exit Condition
core_conditions.description: Either receiving a 'No Request' signal or an OFF command, or failing to receive LIN signal within a timeout period.

core_outputs.name: Color Change
core_outputs.description: The lamp changes its color based on the requested color code.

core_outputs.name: Dimming/Fading
core_outputs.description: The lamp dims or fades according to the specified speed when turned off.

core_outputs.name: Shutdown
core_outputs.description: The lamp is turned off if certain conditions are met or faults occur.

core_faults.name: Overvoltage/Undervoltage Fault
core_faults.description: If the lamp module experiences overvoltage or undervoltage, it will be immediately shut down.

core_faults.name: LIN Communication Timeout
core_faults.description: If no LIN signal is received from ZCU within 6 seconds, the lamp will be shut down.

core_faults.name: Invalid Color Command
core_faults.description: If the DoorFR1LampColorCmd_l signal is abnormal, the lamp will maintain its previous state.

core_timing_constraints.name: LIN Signal Timeout
core_timing_constraints.description: The system expects to receive a LIN signal from ZCU within this time frame; otherwise, the lamp will be turned off.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the logic for controlling the color of the front door FR1 lamp, including how it responds to input commands, handles transitions, exits under specific conditions, and manages fault scenarios. It is primarily used for testing the correct implementation of the lamp's color control functionality and its response to various input signals and fault conditions.
